proof_obligations: Boundedness prefix supremum must yield endpoint membership, not only supremum equal to endpoint

Uniform-continuity prefix set fixes epsilon before taking supremum; complete crossing-point-pair case
No undeclared simultaneous or countable selection of arbitrary real witnesses
All degenerate intervals, zero coefficients, zero absolute bounds and constant inner functions explicit
